text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket has arrrrrived!! Looking 
forward to working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I want luck on my side too, and keep 
winning every single race! So that one 
day, my dream can come true...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOOOH! Thank you so muuuuch for 
choosing me, Trainer! This emotion right 
here is my running pooooower!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
